messages:
Asha (CSM): Heads-up — ZenithCare renewal ~45 days out. Noticed a sharp drop in activity over the last 2 weeks and procurement is now sniffing around a competitor (BlueTensor). New PM replaced our champion. Marking renewal risk MED-HIGH :warning:. Dashboard (internal): https://console.redwood/usage/zenithcare. Quick stats: avg tokens/day 12k -> 2.6k (−78%), active seats 42 -> 7, and an embedding error spike around 2026-03-10. Need triage and playbook.
Diego (AE): Ack. I'll own customer outreach. Can someone confirm whether they ran a Dedicated eval with BlueTensor? Any recent pricing / contract notes I should prep? I'll try to get a sync with the new PM (Evan).
Sam (CS Ops): I can pull the logs. Support saw a ticket about p95/p99 latency rising — chat-gen p95 ~800ms last week. Also found an entry saying they spun up a short Dedicated eval 2 weeks ago per billing flags.
Jules (Solutions Eng): If it's latency + quality, we can propose cache + a quantized model variant to cut tail latencies. Need prompt traces and top-5 flows. I can mock a mitigation slide deck.
Asha (CSM): Proposed immediate actions:
  1) @Diego schedule sync with Evan + procurement (ask what they liked about BlueTensor)
  2) @Sam pull 90/30/7-day heatmap + seat churn CSV
  3) @Jules draft a technical mitigation playbook (latency + embedding fallback)
  4) I'll draft exec sponsor intro + a short commercial bridge (3-month price cap)
Deadline: EOD Thu (3 days)
Diego (AE): Meeting scheduled Thu 11:00am PT — invites sent to Evan and L. Marshall (CFO). I'll surface what they liked (cost? integrability?).
Sam (CS Ops): Pulling charts now, attaching quick snippet:
```
date,avg_tokens,active_seats
2026-02-20,12000,42
2026-03-05,2600,7
```
Support ticket ref: SUP-1987 (latency). Also adding a usage heatmap link to the thread.
Jules (Solutions Eng): Quick tech proposal: run a 2-week targeted caching pilot on their top 5 flows + enable prefix KV cache and try the 8-bit quant variant on staging. Ops needs OK for burst capacity. @infra-bot can you check capacity headroom for a 2-week pilot in us-west-2?
infra-bot: Capacity check queued. Current headroom for burst trials in us-west-2: 6 dedicated nodes spare for 2 weeks. Estimated additional cost covered under promo credits: ~ $2.3k.
Asha (CSM): Also capture product asks — they flagged 'conversation memory' and 'faster embedding times' as top blockers. Please add any quotes we have from interviews to the meeting notes.
Diego (AE): If BlueTensor is cheaper, we may need a short commercial concession. Proposal: 3-month price match + SLA credits if p95 > 500ms. Thoughts?
Sam (CS Ops): Legal prefers not to price-match automatically. Alternative: offer a free 2-week Dedicated trial + named PO for measuring impact, plus a data-driven follow-up. That buys us time and signal.
Jules (Solutions Eng): Tech + trial sounds good. If we can drop latency below 500ms on the top flows during trial, that's a strong retention signal. I'll prepare an A/B test plan and the checklist for enabling caching.
Asha (CSM): I'll draft the outreach email to Evan with the trial + exec intro and circulate for edits. @Diego tag any commercial constraints. Reconvene after Thu meeting. :calendar:
Diego (AE): Got it. Will push for an outcome-focused meeting (success metrics, timeline). Thanks team :thumbsup:
Sam (CS Ops): Pulling final heatmaps now, will post before EOD Thu.
Jules (Solutions Eng): I'll have the playbook + slide deck ready for the meeting.
Asha (CSM): Great — thanks all. If anyone hears anything from procurement before Thu ping the thread. :eyes:
